firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently built something in real life receives the Master Builder hammer and names the first resource. Everyone then places that resource simultaneously.
houseFallback: If the group cannot identify a starter, agree to choose one randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: This entry describes the normal multiplayer setup, not the Town Hall or solo variant.
Players also construct buildings simultaneously. After everyone finishes, the hammer passes to the player on the left for the next round.
